title: Pyjama Diamond
description: This is a Recource Pack for you when you want to have a pyjama in Minecraft!
body:
### Pyjamor Armor
Drift off into battle with the ultimate combination of comfort and protection! The Pyjamor Armor is perfect for sleepy warriors who dream of victory. Designed with soft fabrics and reinforced with netherite, this cozy armor lets you fight in style while staying snug. Whether you're lounging in your base or facing off against a horde of enemies, Pyjamor Armor has got you covered – literally!
